action: const express = require('express'); const fs = require('fs'); const path = require('path'); const app = express(); const PORT = 5000; const LOG_FILE = path.join(__dirname, 'logs.txt'); app.use(express.json()); // Helper function to sanitize input function sanitizeInput(input) { return input.replace(/[\r\n]/g, ' ').trim(); } // Endpoint to log a message app.post('/log', (req, res) => { const { message } = req.body; if (typeof message !== 'string' || !message.trim()) { return res.status(400).send('Message is required and must be a non-empty string'); } const sanitizedMessage = sanitizeInput(message); fs.appendFile(LOG_FILE, sanitizedMessage + '\n', (err) => { if (err) { return res.status(500).send('Failed to log message'); } res.status(200).send('Log message successful'); }); }); // Endpoint to retrieve all logs app.get('/logs', (req, res) => { fs.readFile(LOG_FILE, 'utf8', (err, data) => { if (err) { return res.status(500).send('Failed to retrieve logs'); } res.status(200).type('text/plain').send(data); }); }); app.listen(PORT, '0.0.0.0', () => { console.log(`Server is running on http://0.0.0.0:${PORT}`); });
